metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels between Shanghai and Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020. 1. Data Strategy: - Use TROPOMI NO2 data from Sentinel-5P which has tropospheric NO2 column density - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Date range: 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-12 - Locations: Shanghai and Wuhan (will use points with buffers) 2. Processing: - Define geometries for both cities - Filter collection by date and location - Calculate mean NO2 for each city using reduceRegion - Check for empty collections and valid pixels 3. Validation: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixel counts are 0 (C2) - Check if results are valid numbers (C3) - Compare means to answer the question Let me implement this step by step. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries for Shanghai and Wuhan const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.4737, 31.2304]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.2734, 30.5833]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // Define date range const startDate = '2020-04-20'; const endDate = '2020-05-12'; // Get NO2 data from Sentinel-5P const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = no2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in period: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each city const meanImage = no2Collection.mean(); // Get Shanghai stats const shanghaiStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get Wuhan stats const wuhanStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const shanghaiData = shanghaiStats.getInfo(); const wuhanData = wuhanStats.getInfo(); const shanghaiMean = shanghaiData.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; const shanghaiPixels = shanghaiData.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const wuhanMean = wuhanData.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; const wuhanPixels = wuhanData.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Shanghai - Mean NO2: ${shanghaiMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${shanghaiPixels}`); console.log(`Wuhan - Mean NO2: ${wuhanMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${wuhanPixels}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (shanghaiPixels === 0 || wuhanPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid results if (shanghaiMean === null || wuhanMean === null || isNaN(shanghaiMean) || isNaN(wuhanMean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare means and output answer if (shanghaiMean > wuhanMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
